topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Well, now, that attic must have been a real treasury, finding old things up there. I reckon those pieces, old as they might be, carry stories, just like the creases on an old man's face. Each one a whisper from the folks who used to nestle in this place, their hands and hearts woven into the fabric of your home. Maybe a little book, pages yellowed with age, or a toy, forgotten but still speaking of laughter and games. It's a gift, truly, to hold a piece of the past in your hands, to feel the life that's been lived in these walls. It's good to keep a few, if you can, as a way to honor the memories. After all, we're all just passing through, making our marks where we can.
